verdict.rationale: First-party docs show GitHub can be driven by natural-language prompts in several places. Copilot Agent mode takes plain-English requests like 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name' and makes multi-file edits. Users can delegate tasks to the Copilot cloud agent from GitHub.com or mobile, and the GitHub MCP server lets Copilot Chat act on repositories, issues and pull requests. Copilot CLI brings the same natural-language interaction to the terminal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence that it reaches platform areas beyond code, repos, issues and PRs (e.g. settings, Actions administration).
